chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Alavi (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us, saying: My grandfather narrated to me, saying: Al-Zubayr ibn Abi Bakr narrated to me, saying: Ibrahim ibn Hamzah al-Zubayri narrated to me, from Ibrahim ibn Ali al-Rafi'i, from his father, from his grandmother Bint Abi Rafi', who said:

Fatimah, daughter of the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family), came to the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) with her two sons, Al-Hasan and Al-Hussein (peace be upon them), during the illness in which he passed away. She said: 'O Messenger of God, these are your sons, so bequeath something to them.' He said: 'As for Al-Hasan, he has my majesty and my mastery, and as for Al-Hussein, he has my bravery and my generosity.'
ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad bequeath to his grandsons Hasan and Husayn during his final illness?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Saduq's *Al-Khisal*, this hadith highlights the spiritual inheritance of the Prophet's unique attributes to his grandsons, distinguishing Hasan's dignified leadership (su'dad) from Husayn's courageous generosity (jud). This transmission underscores the Shia belief in the continuity of prophetic character through the Ahl al-Bayt, framing their virtues not merely as personal traits but as divine endowments essential for their roles as Imams.
